english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for undoing a knot, tie, fastening, or similar restraint.
This is the all-purpose choice for undoing a literal knot and for solving a mystery, as in 解開謎團.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for undoing a tangle, solving a complication, or saying that a knot has come undone.
Use 解開 when undo means unfastening a buckle, knot, button, or similar fastening.

examples.english: Please untie my shoelaces for me first.
examples.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 hoi1 tiu4 haai4 daai2 sin1

examples.english: I finally managed to untangle this bundle of earphone wires.
examples.traditional: 呢團耳機線終於畀我解開喇。
examples.jyutping: ne1 tyun4 ji5 gei1 sin3 zung1 jyu1 bei2 ngo5 gaai2 hoi1 laa3

examples.english: I spent all night trying to unravel this tight knot.
examples.traditional: 呢個結太實，我搞咗成晚先解開。
examples.jyutping: nei1 go3 git3 taai3 sat6 ngo5 gaau2 zo2 seng4 maan5 sin1 gaai2 hoi1

examples.english: Can you undo my shoelaces first? I can't walk.
examples.traditional: 你幫我解開條鞋帶先，我行唔到。
examples.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 hoi1 tiu4 haai4 daai2 sin1 ngo5 haang4 m4 dou2

english.note: Use this when unlocking means finding a hidden answer, as when a clue helps someone solve or unravel a mystery.

examples.english: This clue finally helped me unlock the mystery.
examples.traditional: 呢條線索終於幫我解開個謎。
examples.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 sin3 sok3 zung1 jyu1 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 hoi1 go3 mai4
